description: Given the IP address and the User-Agent string of a request (for example from a server log), says whether that IP is inside the IP ranges the bot's operator publishes. The User-Agent is matched against the migurei bot registry (registry/bots); the IP is matched, IPv4 and IPv6, against the operator's published feed snapshot bundled with the registry (the snapshot date and registry version are in the answer). Status: verified (IP is in the operator's published ranges), ip_not_in_feed (the User-Agent names a registered bot but the IP is not in its ranges), no_feed (registered bot, but its operator publishes no IP ranges, so it cannot be checked), unknown_ua (no registered bot matches). Needs no outside request. Only public internet addresses are accepted (private, loopback, link-local, CGNAT, multicast, documentation and reserved addresses are refused). Read-only; the IP address and User-Agent are not stored and not logged. "verified" only means the IP is in the operator's ranges; the snapshot goes stale between updates.

ip.description: One public IPv4 or IPv6 address, for example from the access log.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent header of that request, for example "Mozilla/5.0 AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko; compatible; GPTBot/1.1; +https://openai.com/gptbot)".

name: verify_ai_bot
title: Verify that an IP address is really the AI bot its User-Agent claims
